[context:qualifications] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive states. Never interpret rightMarginalValue m 0 as the economic boundary marginal. The boundary object is zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal and may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is a separate utility endpoint object. H06 and contract D02 use no marginal object; contract D03 and S02 use rightMarginalValue only after proving positivity. A01, A02 and A03 introduce no boundary-marginal substitution.

[context:qualifications] The maintained household scope is bounded utility, continuous resources and a general compact iid-income law. P03's two-point distribution establishes primitive consistency only and does not restrict the general law. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope. H01–H04 retain BASIC-only assumptions and constructed canonical objects without impatience. H01 is a bounded-continuous Bellman self-map on unbounded NNReal with beta contraction; actual actions lie in [0,z], with shares auxiliary. H02 constructs the canonical fixed point, proves uniqueness among bounded continuous fixed points and uniform value iteration, and bounds value using inf U and sup U over all nonnegative consumption. H03 proves ordinary real convex-combination concavity and strict increase without derivatives. H04 constructs the unique actual shifted-asset maximizer, uses shares only at positive resources, handles zero by feasibility, and satisfies c(z)+A(z)=z. No CoreRegularity, impatience, differentiability, invariant-law, bounded-asset or finite-state premise enters H01–H04.

[context:qualifications] P01 proves budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. Equality and borrowing feasibility are separate components; original prices satisfy R=1+r, and the next-resource identity was separately proved. P02 finite-cap continuity fixes the cap and labor floor, treats r=0 separately and includes the zero-cap case without dividing by the cap. Its natural-cap branch requires r>0, gives -r*phi_nat=-w*l_min and effective income w*(l-l_min), and asserts no continuity of the raw natural borrowing limit through zero. P03's consistency witness establishes neither optimization nor stationarity nor equilibrium.

dimension_assessments.summary: Quantifies fixed primitives, every strictly impatient normalized price, and every continuous debt shift; concludes continuity of the actual integral of A_q−phi(q), using the common-compact route.

The sequence and limit share [0,B]. H06 gives uniform policy convergence; min(A_0,B) is a bounded continuous test and equals A_0 on support. The norm estimate and weak limit combine, with both integrands proved integrable before integral_sub.

A_q(z_t) is shifted saving for t+1, and the canonical invariant law is over resources. Subtracting phi gives net assets. Original-price interpretation retains phi≥0 and intercept=−(R−1)phi; no independence of current saving and current labor is asserted.

Rendered A94 eq. (8), printed 668/original PDF 11; A93 Prop. 5, printed 39–40/PDF 40–41; and C90 Prop. 2.4(i), eq. (18), printed 548/PDF 7. They support aggregation and continuity. The common-compact integral proof is new, not a verbatim source proof.

BASIC is structural; smoothness, eventual bounded RRA, endpoint nondegeneracy, fixed iid law, strict impatience, and continuous phi are explicit. M06A derives D03's local uniform bounds rather than assuming them.

Neither continuity of supply nor a supported stationary law is assumed. Canonical laws come from accepted existence/uniqueness; local support and policy convergence are derived. Primitive and smoothness premises are consistent.
The diff adds A03, its nine helper exports, imports and audits. H06, D03, S06 and A02 remain unchanged certified dependencies; the inspected support and integration helpers preserve their premises.

Resources remain NNReal and labor has an arbitrary probability law on a compact interval with essential endpoints. Prices vary in a Euclidean subtype; no grid, density, finite support or endpoint atom is imposed.

A03 uses policy feasibility and continuity at zero, with no marginal object. Its support interval includes zero without assigning an economic meaning to rightMarginalValue m 0. The inherited ENNReal zeroRightMarginal restriction is preserved.

Compact support yields Integrable A for each canonical law and both policies under each tail law before integral_sub. Subtracting finite phi uses integrable_const. Probability mass is one; no infinite ENNReal marginal is converted to Real.

Weak continuity is used only against the clipped bounded continuous limit policy. Uniform policy convergence and local common support separately justify mean convergence. No total-variation continuity or moment convergence from arbitrary initial laws is inferred.
beta*R<1 is exactly the assigned strict-impatience subtype. Curvature is declared, and local uniform bounds are derived. No positive-consumption or positive-minimum-income premise is added to A03.
